front.title: SR Policy Metric-Aware BGP Best Path Selection

abstract.t:
When multiple BGP routes are available for a destination, the interior cost used by the BGP best-path selection procedure may not reflect the metric of the SR Policy associated with the actual forwarding path. This can result in the selection of a BGP route that does not match the intended transport performance.
This document updates the BGP Phase 2 tie-breaking procedure to enable locally configured SR Policy metric-aware best-path selection using metrics specified in the BGP SR Policy metric extensions.This document replaces [I-D.li-idr-sr-policy-metric], retaining and refining its use case and BGP best-path selection enhancements. The BGP SR Policy extensions for carrying SR Policy metrics are merged in [I-D.ietf-idr-sr-policy-metric] .
